text:
Hello everyone,  
I would like to ask for guidance from those who have experience with this topic in Israel.  

I am currently in a relationship with a foreign woman who works as a caregiver. We are not married, we are a couple (boyfriend and girlfriend), and I would like to know what the first steps are to start a process with the Ministry of Interior (Population and Immigration Authority).  

I would really appreciate it if anyone could share their experience or guide me on how to start correctly, what documents to prepare, and what I should be most careful about.  

Thank you in advance for your help.
